description.zh: 文档所在目录，如果不填值是default
description.en: Folder where the document resides. If no value is provided, it defaults to "default".

description.zh: 阿里云百炼业务空间唯一标识：获取[业务空间ID（Workspace ID）](~~2782167~~)
description.en: Unique identifier (UUID) of the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio workspace: obtain the [Workspace ID](~~2587495~~)

descriptions.zh: 文档上传是通过异步调用的方式实现，调用之后需要使用getDocInfo接口进行循环检查文档状态，当文档状态为1时，才能进行后续的文档摘要、生成全文脑图、问答内容总结、抽取关键词、改写等操作。
descriptions.en: Document upload is implemented through asynchronous invocation. After the invocation, you must use the getDocInfo API to periodically check the document status. Only when the document status becomes 1 can you proceed with subsequent operations such as generating a document summary, creating a full-text mind map, summarizing Q&A content, extracting keywords, or rewriting.
